data.gender_notes: Crystie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'krystallos', meaning 'clear' or 'pure'. In ancient Greek culture, 'krystallos' was used to describe something transparent, like ice or clear water. In Christianity, Crystie can symbolize the pure, transparent nature of the soul and its connection to God. The name Crystie carries the meaning “Clear, pure, ice” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Crystie usually hope their child will grow to embody clear, pure, ice and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Crystie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
